title: Rejection probability as a uniform failure probability
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $n$, and let $\pi$ be a Boolean proof word of length $n+(n+1)+(n+1)$. The rejection probability of the specified verifier on input $w$ and proof $\pi$ equals the uniform probability, over its finite seed space, that the corresponding check does not hold.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $n$
$\pi$ is a Boolean vector of length $n+(n+1)+(n+1)$
